findings.title: Hardcoded secret or credential detected
findings.description: Potential Generic hardcoded API secret / key hardcoded in source code.
findings.impact: Source code leaks expose credentials to all repository viewers, leading to unauthorized infrastructure access or data compromise.
findings.recommendation: Store secrets in environment variables or a dedicated secrets manager (e.g., Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
findings.suggested_fix: Replace hardcoded string with os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY') or a configuration loader.

findings.title: SQL injection risk from string formatting
findings.description: Database query 'query' was constructed via string interpolation/concatenation.
findings.impact: Attackers can bypass authentication, read unauthorized database records, or modify/drop entire tables.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or ORM query builders with bind variables.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass parameters as separate tuple/dict arguments: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s', (user_id,))

findings.title: Production debug mode hardcoded to True
findings.description: debug=True explicitly passed to framework call.
findings.impact: Debug mode in production exposes interactive web shells, stack traces, and detailed system internals to external users.
findings.recommendation: Read debug configuration exclusively from environment variables with a default of False in production.

findings.title: Synchronous blocking call in async function
findings.description: Blocking call 'time.sleep()' invoked inside async function 'get_user'. Use asyncio.sleep() instead.
findings.impact: Completely blocks the single-threaded asyncio event loop, halting all concurrent requests and destroying backend throughput.
findings.recommendation: Replace blocking synchronous calls with their non-blocking asynchronous equivalents.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with await asyncio.sleep() or an async HTTP client like httpx.
findings.evidence: Call to time.sleep() at line 33 inside async def get_user

findings.title: Direct raw SQL execution inside route endpoint
findings.impact: Violates separation of concerns, mixes HTTP transport with database schemas, and makes unit testing endpoints difficult.
findings.recommendation: Move database queries into a dedicated repository or service class injected via Depends().
findings.suggested_fix: Create a UserRepository and inject it into the route handler via Depends(get_user_repo).

findings.title: Silent exception swallowing
findings.description: Exception caught and swallowed silently with 'pass'.
findings.impact: Critical bugs, database corruptions, and network timeouts are hidden, making production debugging almost impossible.
findings.recommendation: Always log the exception with stack trace or re-raise it.
findings.suggested_fix: Log the exception with logger.exception('Context description') or re-raise.

findings.title: Potential N+1 query pattern detected in loop
findings.description: Database query 'db.get()' executed inside loop iteration.
findings.impact: Drastically multiplies database latency and round-trips; an endpoint returning 100 items executes 101 queries.
findings.recommendation: Use eager loading (e.g., joinedload, selectinload) or fetch records in a single batched IN query.
findings.suggested_fix: Batch query IDs using .filter(Model.id.in_(ids)) outside the loop or use eager loading.

findings.title: Unpinned dependency version in production manifest
findings.description: Dependency 'fastapi' is completely unpinned without version constraints.
findings.impact: Builds are non-deterministic; upstream minor or major breaking updates can cause production outages without notice.
findings.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific or compatible version ranges (e.g., package==1.2.3 or package~=1.2.0).
findings.suggested_fix: Specify exact or compatible version specifiers in the dependency manifest.

findings.title: Missing health check or liveness endpoint
findings.description: No standard health probe endpoint (/health or /healthz) discovered in backend API.
findings.impact: Container orchestrators (Kubernetes, AWS ECS) and load balancers cannot monitor container liveness or readiness.
findings.recommendation: Expose a lightweight GET /health or /healthz route that checks database connectivity and returns 200 OK.
